ctaDesc: Dibanisa namawaka abantu baseMzantsi Afrika abathemba i-SASSA Help Hub ngolwazi oluchanekileyo, oluhlaziyiweyo.
footerAbout: Isixhobo esizimeleyo esibonelela ngolwazi oluchanekileyo lwe-SASSA, iimini zentlawulo, kunye nokukhusela kobuqhetseba kubantu abafumana uncedo eMzantsi Afrika.
footerDisclaimer: Olu lulwazi oluzimeleyo, olungekho ngokusesikweni. Njalo qinisekisa ulwazi kwiindlela ezisemthethweni ze-SASSA.
emergencyNotice: 🚨 Imeko Yangxamiseko: Ngemibuzo engxamisekileyo ye-SASSA, biza 0800 60 10 11 okanye undwendwele eyona ofisi ye-SASSA ikufutshane.
faqDescription: Fumana iimpendulo kwezona mibuzo iqhelekileyo malunga neenkonzo ze-SASSA, iintlawulo, kunye neemfuno zokufaneleka.
noFaqsFound: Akukho mibuzo eqhelekileyo ifunyenweyo ehambelana nokuba khangela kwakho.
